title: RCA, Columbia and Decca houseman work
summary: Estavil, Joe Carlton, Hugo Winterhalter and Herman Diaz.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Scared everybody to death. You remember a guy named Estavil (PHONETIC) we used to record with? Mexican piano player at RCA.
He used to come up from Mexico when they'd put those big bands together.
I think you and I were housemen down there.
Yeah, we did quite a business.
Yeah, a lot of work down there. Well, for quite a few years I was pretty lucky, I did RCA and Columbia and Decca.
And Hugo Winterhalter and there was a Latin guy down there, played. What was his name? I can't recall his name right now.
Yeah, I can visualize him. Herman Diaz.
Herman Diaz, right. We were very fortunate to work down there.
I know you don't remember too much about those guys
